novelty.actual_existing_label_test: similar_rows_jan_jul.py lines333-432 is more than training-subset selection: same-airport weighted-percentile nearest training LABEL means for K5/20/50/200, then other-month-fitted residual blending against the older v58 practice recipe.
novelty.other_overlaps: Nearest-50 subset refitting was tested as v59; local/full-day neural cohort branches used input-only peers and explicitly prohibited donor labels. Existing grouped history target averages do not implement learned query-donor attention.
novelty.not_tested_in_searched_evidence: Trainable retrieval metric plus query-donor feature-difference values and training-target embeddings, jointly trained for prediction; pretrained TabICLv2 regression/ICL.
novelty.claim_limit: Plain label-KNN is failed historical evidence, not novel. No located learned-retrieval implementation means untested, not proven promising or failed. This is a new conditional-memory mechanism rather than width/depth tuning.

primary_sources.use: Official TabR source: learned K keys, nearest-candidate search, softmax squared-distance attention, label embedding plus key-difference transform, self removal, and training-only candidate labels. The small screen below is explicitly inspired by this mechanism, not a claim of reproducing paper settings.
Official implementation uses Faiss and offers memory-efficient/context-freeze variants. Full million-row dynamic-bank cost should not be assumed small.

Current TabICLv2 supports regression; original v1/v1.1 were classification-only. Current documentation reports good 300-100000-row benchmark coverage and larger offloading modes. This is a separate pretrained ICL approach, not an already-tested or already-installed PRC model.
Regressor checkpoint/API and caching exist; pretrained weights/dependencies would need separately reviewed pinning. No download/install proposed for this first screen.

fixed_small_falsifier.hypothesis: Observed labels of learned-nearby training flights contain useful local conditional information beyond an otherwise identical input-only retrieval model.
fixed_small_falsifier.test_month: 2025-04 only; all eligible departures, every airport. This is a training-period research holdout, not the reused Jan/Jul development set and not official/final validation.
fixed_small_falsifier.sampling: At most4096 input-selected training departures per airport, ascending SHA256(retrieval42:MVT_ID); at most512 donor rows per airport from that same selected training set, separate fixed SHA256(bank42:MVT_ID) ordering. No label-based oversampling/filtering except finite supervised targets; persist exclusions. Full finite-target April population used for scoring.
fixed_small_falsifier.features: Exactly the37 source-blind raw/physical columns from posterior_aware_crossfit.FEATURES, expanded from its prior Rome-only projection to all airports. Existing all-airport input-only flight_cohort_context meta/values supply17 physical transforms. No history target encodings, public-source calibration, saved-model embeddings or teacher predictions.
fixed_small_falsifier.preprocessing: Fit categorical vocabularies and numerical median/IQR scales on selected training rows only; unknown categories map to0, missing numeric flags retained, zero IQR maps to1. Numeric values clipped to[-10,10] after scaling. Target mean/std from training labels only, std0 fails closed.
fixed_small_falsifier.architecture: Category embeddings8; two128-unit ReLU encoder layers, no encoder dropout; learned64-dimensional key. Exact PyTorch same-airport K16 retrieval. Context value =128-dimensional linear normalized-label encoding plus64->128->128 ReLU key-difference transform. Add context to128-dimensional query representation; one128-unit ReLU/dropout0.1 predictor block and scalar linear output. Label encoder starts with zero weights/bias in both arms.
arms: labels_off: same donor features/architecture/parameters, all context target inputs replaced with0
fixed_small_falsifier.matched_training: Seed42; identical initial weights, row permutations, batches and dropout streams; AdamW lr0.001, weight_decay0.0003, batch256, exactly10epochs, no early stopping, scheduler, sweep or selected checkpoint. Same training labels/examples and optimizer-update count in both arms. Save both final checkpoints/predictions before any April labels are read.
fixed_small_falsifier.retrieval_execution: Encode donor keys without gradients each batch, select exact nearest candidates, then recompute selected keys/values with gradients. Stable distance ties by original donor movement ID. Query and donor search keys contain inputs only; no target-dependent neighbor selection.
fixed_small_falsifier.label_firewall: April excluded from preprocessing, reference/metric fitting, donor bank and all optimization. January/July labels never opened. Query own movement and shared-identity/signature/120-second aircraft aliases excluded; purge any selected train row aliased to April using inputs only. During training also exclude same UTC-day donors so training cannot rely on contemporaneous labels unavailable to whole-month queries. Fewer than16 admissible donors fails preflight, with no changed K.
fixed_small_falsifier.checks_before_labels: Input/ID/scope audit; April-label poison invariance; bank permutation equivariance and self/alias exclusion; labels_on/off initialization parity; exact checkpoint reload; outputs finite and complete. Float outputs converted once by max(0)+nearest-even for both arms; no additional old recipe/posterior correction.
fixed_small_falsifier.evaluation_and_gate: One raw April taxi RMSE comparison labels_on versus labels_off, paired UTC-day bootstrap2000 draws seed20261013. Allocation signal requires improvement and upper95% delta<0. Report effect size, airport results and donor coverage descriptively; no group-specific selection. A pass justifies a separately designed full-feature current-family test, not an upload or v80 gain claim.
fixed_small_falsifier.failure_interpretation: A negative screen closes this fixed low-cost37-feature/bank/architecture test. It does not prove all retrieval models fail; a positive result also does not show information missing from the much stronger current TabM/v80 stack.
fixed_small_falsifier.resources: Existing torch/numpy/scipy available; faiss/tabicl/sklearn absent in current environment. Exact blocked PyTorch search avoids installations. At most40960 training rows and5120 donors; compact matrices/keys are tens of MB, distance block about5MB at256x5120 float32. Estimate10-30minutes one GPU plus narrow-column preparation/exports; unbenchmarked, memory/runtime preflight required before allocation.
fixed_small_falsifier.why_not_full_Tabr_or_TabICL_first: No honest untouched-month current TabM encoder is available for free: existing checkpoints were trained on other training months including April. Starting fresh is necessary. Full2M dynamic retrieval or external foundation-model setup is unnecessary for this bounded mechanism test.

scientific_expectation: Gain is unknown. Prior plain-KNN failures lower the prior probability of benefit, but do not test jointly learned retrieval. No advance1-second official gain claim is required or made.
